video_title: Why Kyrie, Steph, and KD Are Still Torching the NBA | LeBron James

quotes.speaker: Steve Nash
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Nash on the high percentage of injured or doubtful players
quotes.excerpt: 15% of the league was either doubtful or injured.
quotes.quote: There was a number this week, tip-off, there was 15% of the league was either doubtful or injured. Just big picture, do you feel like there's more injuries this year?

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on the difficulty of simulating game speed in off-season training
quotes.excerpt: There's no way that you can simulate the way we're playing in today's game to off-season training.
quotes.quote: There's no way that you can simulate the way we're playing in today's game to off-season training. You can do as much as you can, but to jump right into full throttle of how we're playing the game today, I think it's very, very challenging.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on the impact of injuries on the Oklahoma City Thunder's potential
quotes.excerpt: They never really got to see the full potential of what their team could be last year.
quotes.quote: He started the season with the wrist, then he had the hamstring that was reoccurring all year, so they never really got to see the full potential of what their team could be last year. Obviously, they know what they look like when they're whole.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James recalls Gordon Hayward's injury in Cleveland
quotes.excerpt: I was literally on the floor when Gordon Hayward fractured his ankle in Cleveland.
quotes.quote: I was literally on the floor when Gordon Hayward fractured his ankle in Cleveland. The reaction is the same reaction, you kind of what the hell just happened and you just feel for that player at that particular time.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on Cason Wallace's defensive impact
quotes.excerpt: Cason Wallace is able to come off the bench, spark them with the defensive prowess.
quotes.quote: Cason Wallace is able to come off the bench, spark them with the defensive prowess, him picking up full court and being a knack there and was shooting the ball particularly well from the outside.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on the intensity of modern NBA players
quotes.excerpt: If you just think that they were just kind of running at 50 or 60% during their practice rounds.
quotes.quote: If you just think that they were just kind of running at 50 or 60% during their practice rounds and then the Olympic, you know, happened, three rounds to get to the finals and now the gun goes off and they're taking off full speed. There's a feel like there's going to be some potential injury that happens.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on the dangers of reduced preseason games
quotes.excerpt: The amount of performance teams that's now telling you guys to not play as much is actually detrimental.
quotes.quote: The amount of performance teams that's now telling you guys to not play as much is actually detrimental to our players.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on Russell Westbrook's competitive nature
quotes.excerpt: One of the most fierce competitors that the game has ever seen.
quotes.quote: One of the most fierce competitors that the game has ever seen. Obviously, triple-double king, MVP, gold medalist, been to the finals, scoring champ.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on Russell Westbrook's dedication to playing every game
quotes.excerpt: The guy never wanted to take a night off. Wanted to play in every single game.
quotes.quote: The guy never wanted to take a night off. Wanted to play in every single game. Being a teammate of his for that year, two, I think it was year and a half, maybe two years in LA, never wanted to take a game off, never wanted to take a practice off.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James clarifies his 2015 NBA Finals scoring performance
quotes.excerpt: I don't think I have 44 that game. Maybe the next year.
quotes.quote: Kevin Love is hurt. No, I don't think I have 44 that game. Maybe the next year. Kevin Love got hurt my first year in Cleveland, tore his shoulder, separated his shoulder. Kyrie in overtime, fractured his kneecap.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on his growth and learning process in Cleveland
quotes.excerpt: Everything that he wanted, everything that he knew he wanted, he was able to go and find it.
quotes.quote: Everything that he wanted, everything that he knew he wanted, he was able to go and find it and bring that mentality and that knowledge back home.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on his focus during his return to Cleveland
quotes.excerpt: I was just living in the moment and you know, just trying to make an imprint on the organization.
quotes.quote: I was just living in the moment and you know, just trying to make an imprint on the organization and the franchise that hadn't been there and making an impact on a group of guys, the majority haven't been there.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on his longevity and perspective
quotes.excerpt: There's no way if you would have told me in 2014-15 that I would be playing in 2026-27.
quotes.quote: There's no way if you would have told me in 2014-15 that I would be playing in 2026-27. That doesn't even sound right, it doesn't even sound right.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on his evolving role and playing style
quotes.excerpt: Now it's just more like picking my spots. I'm able to do pretty much everything I was doing 12 years ago.
quotes.quote: Now it's just more like picking my spots. I'm able to do pretty much everything I was doing 12 years ago, but more is just more in like spurts and picking my spots and understanding now what I wasn't playing with Joel Embiid and Tyrese Maxey, or like last year playing with Luka Doncic.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on his reduced usage rate
quotes.excerpt: My usage is a lot lower than it was 12 years ago and rightfully so.
quotes.quote: My usage is a lot lower than it was 12 years ago and rightfully so, and that's just about a growth mindset.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on the importance of being a connector
quotes.excerpt: I see a player in you now that is happy to be a connector.
quotes.quote: I see a player in you now that is happy to be a connector, not have to create always the advantage, but happy to take what little advantage someone created and now be the player that could be the connector.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on his desire to inspire the younger generation
quotes.excerpt: We hope that we can inspire the younger generation behind us.
quotes.quote: We hope that we can inspire the younger generation behind us to kind of, if you want to have a long-lasting, dominating career, longevity career, that it's not just about showing up and putting the uniform on and playing.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on the importance of being a 'table setter'
quotes.excerpt: I can be more of a table setter, you know, now 12 years later and year 24.
quotes.quote: I can be more of a table setter, you know, now 12 years later and year 24.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on the evolution of NBA team rosters
quotes.excerpt: When I first came into the league, it was Mike Bibby, he was the point guard.
quotes.quote: When I first came into the league, it was Mike Bibby, he was the point guard. Doug Christie was the two guard, Peja was the small forward, Brad Miller at the power forward, and Vlade at the center. There wasn't like if-ands-or-buts, who was in what position. It was like, okay, if the five man is in the middle of the floor, he's trailing. The point guard is bringing the ball up, the wings run to the side, and wherever the one of the bigs, whatever big was there first, you take the ball out, the other big run all the way down the floor and get to the dunker.
